name: led_indicator
summary: A red 0603 LED driven from a pin (GPIO or supply) through a series resistor sized for the chosen current.

sources.document: Kingbright APT1608EC, spec DSAD0924 / 1203001652: VF 2.0 V typ (2.5 V max) at IF 20 mA; DC forward current 30 mA max
Ohm's law: R = (V_drive - V_F) / I_F, rounded up to the next E24 value so the current does not exceed the target
Copper design default: 2 mA, a modest indicator current that most GPIOs can source
sources.standard: Copper design choice (2026-11-21), not a datasheet value

ports.name: drive
ports.note: a GPIO (high = on) or a supply rail

notes.text: VF is the typical value at 20 mA; at 2 mA the real VF is lower, so the real current is somewhat higher than the target. The current maximum is 30 mA.
drive_voltage starts at 2.5 V: the LED's maximum VF at 20 mA.
